definition: A centered window that appears on top of the page and blocks everything behind it until the person responds or dismisses it.
whenToUse: Short forms that need full focus

notConfusedWith.difference: Slides in from an edge and usually holds more content.
Small and anchored to a button; the page stays usable.
Appears briefly and doesn't block anything.

prompts.short: Add a centered modal with title, body, Cancel and Confirm buttons. Trap focus.
prompts.detailed: Add a centered modal (max-width 480px) with a title, body text, and Cancel/Confirm buttons over a dimmed backdrop. Trap focus, close on Esc, lock page scroll while open, and use the dialog role with aria-modal and aria-labelledby.
